title: Extrude Takes Vector
description: procedural: extrude should take a vector.
summary: Fixed circle + extrude showing nothing in procedural preview. Root causes: curve circle edges lacked circle profile metadata so extrude produced untessellatable solids; draw circle profiles could fail preview tessellation; extrude default vector magnitude was 1 (invisible extrusion). Added circle profile to circleCurveSync, unified drawCircleSync on sketchCircle, default extrude vector [0,0,5], default fixture wires circle sketch → vector (z=5 slider) → extrude → preview.
